# itna na apne jame se bahar nikal ke chal. #### itna na apne jame se bahar nikal ke chal. itnā na apne jaame se bāhar nikal ke chal. duniyā hai chal-chalāv kā rasta sambhal ke chal. mānind josh-e-ġham na ziyāda ubal ke chal. fursat hai ik sadā kī yahāñ soz-e-dil ke saath. us par sapand-vār na itnā uchhal ke chal. saa.e se bach ke ahl-e-fareb-o-daġhal ke chal. auroñ ke bal pe bal na kar itnā na chal nikal. bal hai to bal ke bal pe tū kuchh apne bal ke chal. aur aap hī vo kahtā hai putle ko kal ke chal. kahtā hai kaun tujh ko na chal chal sambhal ke chal. tū laakh apnī chaal ko zālim badal ke chal. parvāna apne dil se ye kahtā hai jal ke chal. do-chār tiir paik se aage ajal ke chal. to kah do us ko taur pe tū is ġhazal ke chal. itna na apne jame se bahar nikal ke chal. duniya hai chal-chalaw ka rasta sambhal ke chal. manind josh-e-gham na ziyaada ubal ke chal. fursat hai ek sada ki yahan soz-e-dil ke sath. us par sapand-war na itna uchhal ke chal. sae se bach ke ahl-e-fareb-o-daghal ke chal. auron ke bal pe bal na kar itna na chal nikal. bal hai to bal ke bal pe tu kuchh apne bal ke chal. aur aap hi wo kahta hai putle ko kal ke chal. kahta hai kaun tujh ko na chal chal sambhal ke chal. tu lakh apni chaal ko zalim badal ke chal. parwana apne dil se ye kahta hai jal ke chal. bulbul ke hosh nikhat-e-gul ki tarah uDa. gulshan mein mere sath zara itr mal ke chal. do-chaar tir paik se aage ajal ke chal. to kah do us ko taur pe tu is ghazal ke chal.
